tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
VSOL V1600G2-B 16-Port GPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal for Scalable Fiber Networks

The V1600G2-B 16-Port GPON OLT is a high-capacity, carrier-grade optical line terminal designed for FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home), FTTP (Fiber-to-the-Premises), and large-scale fiber-optic networks. Built for ISPs, telecom providers, and enterprise networking, this powerful and scalable OLT ensures high-speed, low-latency data transmission with advanced reliability and energy efficiency.


Key Features 

  • 16 x GPON Ports – Supports up to 2,048 ONUs (1:128 per port) for high-density GPON deployments.
  • High-Speed Uplink Connectivity – Equipped with 4 x GE (RJ45) ports and 4 x 10GE (SFP+) ports for seamless network expansion and ultra-fast data transmission.
  • Dual Power Modules (AC/DC) with Hot-Swap Support – Ensures uninterrupted operation, enhancing network reliability and stability.
  • Scalable & Future-Proof Design – Ideal for expanding fiber broadband networks, ensuring long-term growth and performance.
  • Compact, Rack-Mountable Build – 1U design for efficient deployment in data centers, telecom racks, and enterprise cabinets.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600G2-B
  • GPON Ports: 16 x GPON SFP slots
  • Uplink Ports: 4 x GE (RJ45) + 4 x 10GE (SFP+)
  • Splitting Ratio: 1:128 per GPON port
  • Chassis: 1U, rack-mountable
  • Power Supply: Dual AC/DC modules, hot-swappable
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP Broadband Networks – Delivers high-speed, low-latency fiber internet for residential and business users.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – A scalable GPON solution for expanding fiber-optic services.
  • Enterprise & Corporate Networking – Supports large-scale business applications with high bandwidth and stable connectivity.
  • Smart City & IoT Deployments – Provides seamless high-speed connectivity for surveillance, IoT devices, and automation systems.


Why Choose the V1600G2-B 16-Port GPON OLT?

  • High-Capacity GPON Support – Connect up to 2,048 ONUs with fast, reliable fiber access.
  • Fast & Scalable Uplink Options – 10GE ports ensure seamless, high-speed data transmission.
  • Redundant & Reliable Power Supply – Dual AC/DC modules with hot-swap capability for uninterrupted performance.
  • Compact, Rack-Mountable Design – 1U form factor for efficient installation and space-saving deployment.
  • Optimized for Cost & Energy Efficiency – Low power consumption, reducing operational costs.
